name: Tile dungeon crawl
summary: Tap to move through a small grid dungeon one step at a time; enemies act after you, and you grab loot on the way to the stairs.
core_loop: tap a tile → hero moves one step → enemies move → fight or pick up loot → reach stairs
rules: enemies move only when you do
bumping into an enemy attacks it
stairs lead to the next floor
example_prompts: a pixel dungeon where the monsters are my teachers
roguelike dungeon crawl set in a haunted mall
turn based dungeon with cats
dungeon crawl where i'm a baker

name: Branching route map
summary: Choose a path across a map of nodes (fight, shop, rest, event) toward a boss, balancing HP and gold.
core_loop: view map → pick next node → resolve node → heal or gain → repeat → boss
rules: paths branch and cannot be undone
social_hooks: compare route choices on same seed
example_prompts: slay the spire map but i'm a toaster
roguelike route through a haunted school
choose-your-path adventure to a dragon boss

name: Menu battle
summary: Pick attack, skill, guard or item each turn in a classic menu fight against a monster with a few exploitable weaknesses.
core_loop: enemy telegraphs → choose action → damage resolves → enemy acts → repeat until one side is down
social_hooks: same boss for a Group daily
example_prompts: final fantasy but the boss is my exam
jrpg battle menu with a cat wizard
dragon quest style fight against a giant pizza
pokemon style battle at the school

name: Dice-assign dungeon
summary: Roll dice each turn and slot them into equipment that attacks, defends or heals according to the slot's rule.
core_loop: roll dice → assign each to a slot → slot effects fire → enemy turn → repeat
rules: each slot has a condition (even only, 5 or higher)
gear can be upgraded between fights
social_hooks: share a build that crushed a boss
example_prompts: dicey dungeons but all my gear is kitchen tools
dice dungeon with wizards
roll dice to attack a dragon

name: Loot pick and equip
summary: After each fight pick one of three gear pieces with stat trade-offs; the build you assemble faces a final boss.
core_loop: win fight → see 3 loot options → pick one → stats update → next fight
rules: loot has rarity and stat trade-offs
example_prompts: loot dungeon but all the loot is socks
pick gear to fight a dragon boss
hades style boons in a space station

after a dodge the boss is open for 1-2 s

dodge and strike a dragon

name: Fog-of-war explore
